text: In this month we mostly spoke with one voice about one event. The phrase most of us repeated was "address to congress" — 45 of us on 2025-03-04. Close behind, 41 said "joint address to congress" the same day; 27 said "trump’s joint address," 26 "trump’s joint address to congress." 30 of us invoked "the american dream." One week later the record shifts to appropriations: 29 said "continuing appropriations and extensions act" on 2025-03-11, 28 "full-year continuing appropriations and extensions act," 25 "the full-year continuing appropriations and extensions." Two dates hold nearly everything we said: the address, then the appropriations. We arrived at the same words within the same day.
